item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026_IR_14_PC_DAFNAE_MORARI - Multi-model applications for the territorial assessment of key agri-environmental indicators of cropping systems in the Veneto Region (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Legnaro (Pd)
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

Between 2022 and 2025, the collaboration between the Veneto Region and DAFNAE, established under Regional GovernmentResolution (DGR) No. 282 of 22 March 2022, supported the calculation of agri-environmental indicators using spatial datasets. Theproposed project will build on this work to assess alternative mitigation scenarios based on agri-environmental measures for thepost-2025 period. The monitoring and assessment programme will comprise three complementary components: a) lysimeterexperiments; b) model calibration and validation; c) regional-scale application of the integrated modelling framework to assess theenvironmental outcomes of mitigation measures.

item.description:

Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The activity aims to support the olive and olive oil supply chain by identifying genetic and epigenetic determinants associated with the main agronomic and quality traits of olive. The study will be carried out on about 200 genotypes representative of Italian genetic resources, varieties from other countries and materials derived from inter-varietal crosses, from which the most informative ones will be selected for each trait. The researcher will conduct genetic analyses and association studies to identify variants associated with the traits of interest, integrating these findings with epigenetic and transcriptomic data through a multi-omics approach. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Interactions between innovative cover crops, grain legumes, and weeds – the role of allelopathy. (Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 12:00
Institution: Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA, Pisa
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The candidate will determine the allelopathic potential of innovative cover crops belonging to the Brassicaceae and Fabaceae families by assessing their effects on the germination and growth of target species. He/She will also be responsible for identifying and characterizing the bioactive compounds released by these cover crops. Furthermore, the candidate will actively participate in the chickpea Living Lab activities coordinated by Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, working with Living Lab members to evaluate whether and how innovative cover crops can be incorporated into crop rotations to optimize weed management in subsequent chickpea crops.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Definition of innovative agronomic protocols for the productive and qualitative enhancement of durum wheat in Southern Italy (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The project involves the development and validation of innovative agronomic protocols for the valorization of durum wheat. The strategies adopted will include the use of new generation biostimulants (both microbial and non-microbial), with the aim of reducing chemical inputs and promoting environmental sustainability. The effectiveness of these approaches will be evaluated in the field through the monitoring of the physiological and production parameters of the crop. Finally, the environmental impact of the proposed methods will be quantified through the Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology

Specifically, the candidate will be responsible for the development and optimization of innovative, multidisciplinary experimental setups dedicated to integrating chemical and vibrational communication in reproductive and aggregation contexts. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The project involves activities related to the various stages of the strawberry breeding program, from the selection and implementation of crossing combinations to selection techniques and phenotypic evaluation of seedlings and selections obtained for yield, resistance to biotic and abiotic factors, and sensory and nutritional quality analysis. The research program also requires expertise in crop management, various phenotyping methodologies, and fruit quality control, as well as strawberry propagation techniques, including in vitro methods. Expertise in the analysis of data obtained from phenotyping and genotyping studies is also considered relevant.

Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

Production and morphophysiological characterisation of tomato plants grown under different sodium regimes, to be used in feeding bioassays with phytophagous insects aimed at assessing the nutritional role of this element and identifying the concentrations required to ensure normal insect development, survival, and reproduction.
